input.summary: Replace three-year take-or-pay minimum with no minimum commitment; fees payable for ordered/used Services only
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay commitment with no reduction or termination right, so we have replaced Section 2.1 with our standard position that fees are payable only for Services ordered or used. If a commitment is commercially necessary, we can discuss limiting it to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up rather than a shortfall penalty. This also removes the conflict with Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer makes no minimum purchase, volume, or take-or-pay commitment. Customer is obligated to pay only for Services ordered under an Order Form or actually used, and no shortfall, unused-capacity, or similar charge applies.
